summary: Pampa Energía S.A. furnished a Form -6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release for the period ended September 30, 2026, filed November 2, 2026. Reported sales were US$790 million, up 34% year-on-year, driven by World Electricity Market normalization, stronger spot prices, gas-to-CCGT flows, crude sales and Reformer prices. Adjusted EBITDA reached US$398 million, up 23%, and net income attributable to shareholders was US$129 million, roughly six times the prior-year quarter. Net debt stood at US$1.731 billion versus US$1.319 billion at June 2026. This is a routine results announcement, not a corporate special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation or advisor were disclosed.
